name: Brute force — lockout storm
kql: SecurityEvent | where EventID == 4740 | summarize count() by Computer, bin(TimeGenerated, 1h) | where count_ >= 5
spl: index=windows sourcetype=WinEventLog:Security EventCode=4740 | stats count by host, _time | where count > 5
tuning: Lockout storms across accounts = spray; single-account = targeted.
